name: What is the fastest way to permit a detached ADU in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the fastest way to get a detached ADU permitted in Los Angeles without getting stuck in corrections?
mainEntity.text: What is the fastest way to get a detached ADU permitted in Los Angeles without getting stuck in corrections?

acceptedAnswer.text: The quickest detached ADU permit path is the one that reduces plan check corrections. That usually means a design that fits by-right standards, uses accurate site measurements, and avoids complicated grading, fire access, easements, or zoning issues. Pre-approved plans or standardized construction sets can also shorten review time when the property conditions are simple enough to qualify. Before submitting, the team should verify setbacks, lot coverage, height, utility routing, and any special constraints such as hillside conditions or historic overlays. Incomplete surveys and vague site plans are common reasons permits slow down. A good approach is to do a feasibility review first, then produce a permit-ready set that anticipates agency comments. Homeowners should also ask whether the contractor or designer handles resubmittals, because fast permitting depends on quick responses to corrections. The fastest projects are usually the ones that are boring to reviewers: clean, complete, and technically consistent from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: The fastest path is usually a complete, code-aligned submittal using a straightforward detached ADU design, accurate site information, and drawings prepared to avoid correction cycles. Pre-approved or standardized plans can move faster than fully custom plans when the lot and layout qualify.
